spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (दधते)
1 To hold, to possess or retain.
2 To give, to present, to assign or make over.
(इ) दधि (दन्धति)
To nourish.

mfn. (-धः-धा-धं)
Who has or possesses.
E.
धा to have, श aff.

mfn. (-धन्-धती-धत्)
Having, holding, possessing.
E.
धा to have, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Having, holding, possessing.
E.
धा to have, शानच् aff.

mfn. (-धिः-धिः-धि)
Holding, having, who or what has or possesses.
n. (-धि)
1 Milk curdled or coagulated spontaneously by heat, or by the addition of buttermilk; it is an article of food of general use, and in high estimation amongst the Hindus, and is considered, medicinally, as the remedy or preventative of most disorders.
2 Resin, turpentine; (all the synonyms are common to these two senses.)
3 A house, an abode.
E.
धा to have, किन् affix, and the root reiterated.

f. (-का)
A mixture of boiled and coagulated milk, or of water and sour curds.
E.
दधि as above, and कूर्च्चिका inspissated milk.

m. (-रः)
The churning stick.
E.
दधि curdled milk, and चर to move, in the causal form, affix अच्.

n. (-जं)
Fresh butter.
E.
दधि curdled milk, and ज born.

m. (-त्थः)
The wood-apple: see कपित्थ.
E.
दधि, स्था to stand or be, affix ड; the root yielding a juice compared to curdled milk.

f. (-नुः)
A quantity of curds given away at any sacrifice.
E.
दधि, and धेनु a cow.

f. (-का)
A flower, (Clitorea ternata.)
E.
दधि curdled milk, and पुष्प a flower, कन् added in the fem. form.

m. (-लः)
The elephant or wood-apple; also दधित्थ.
E.
दधि curdled milk, and फल fruit, the fruit having the acid taste of Dahī or Dadhi.

n. (-ण्डं)
A vessel for holding curds, a pail.
E.
दधि, and भाण्ड a vessel.

m. (-ण्डः)
Whey.
E.
दधि, and मण्ड scum.

m. (-दः)
The sea of curds, or rather of whey.
E.
दधिमण्ड, and उद water.

m. (-णः)
A monkey.
E.
दधि, and शोण crimson; of a colour composed of that of curdled milk and crimson.

m. plu. always (-क्तवः)
Barley meal mixed with curds.
E.
दधि, and सक्तु the meal of barley, after frying and grinding.

m. (-रः)
The skim of coagulated milk; also सर only.
E.
दधि Dahī, and सर which goes on or upon.

m. (-रः)
Fresh butter.
E.
दधि curdled milk, and सर essence.

m. (-हः)
Skim of Dahī, or curdled milk whey.
E.
दधि curdled milk, and स्नेह oily substance.

m. (-दः)
Buttermilk.
E.
दधि as above, and स्वेद exudation.

m. (-चः)
The name of a Muni or saint, famous for having devoted himself to death, that the gods might be armed with his bones in lieu of thunderbolts; they being the only effective weapons against the demon VṚTRA; also दधीचि.

m. (-चिः)
A Muni or saint: see the last.

n. (-स्थि)
1 The diamond.
2 The thunderbolt.
E.
दधीचि a saint, and अस्थि a bone; the bones of the saint were converted into thunderbolts, which are of the same substance with the diamond, according to the Hindus.

mfn. (-धृक्)
Shameless, impudent.
E.
धृष to be vain, affix क्विन्, deriv. irr.

m. (-ध्नः)
A name of YAMA.
E.
धा to have, reiterated, and न aff.

m. (-रः)
The sea of curds.
E.
दधि, and आकर a mine.

f. (-नी)
A medicinal plant: see कटुकी.
E.
दधि curdled milk, नी with आङ् prefixed, affix क्विप्.

m. (-ह्वः)
The wood-apple.
E.
दधि, and आह्वा name.

n. (-रं)
The skim of curdled milk, whey.
E.
दधि, and उत्तर upper part; also with कन् added, दध्युत्तरक, n. (-कं.)

m. (-दः)
The sea of curds.
E.
दधि, and उद water; that which has curds for water.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Made of or from Dadhi, or coagulated milk, mixed with it, sprinkled with it, &c.
E.
दधि, and ठक् aff.
